basics.name: Talal Ahmed
basics.label: SOC Analyst
basics.summary: CompTIA Security+ certified Computer Science graduate (CGPA 3.79, Bronze Medal) with hands-on SOC experience from two assessed internship programmes. Deploys and tunes Wazuh, writes detection rules, and hunts through endpoint, firewall, and Windows event telemetry. Publishes public writeups on forensics, AI security, and cloud attack paths.

work.name: SecureNetics
work.summary: SOC Internship Programme · Team Epsilon · 8 assessed assignments
highlights: Completed an eight-week SOC internship programme, delivering an assessed technical report each week across log analysis, Wazuh deployment, threat hunting, DFIR, and SOC operations.
Built the lab environment the programme ran on: Ubuntu Server 24.04 with an all-in-one Wazuh stack and a Linux Mint monitored endpoint in VMware.
Produced 8 structured reports with evidence, analysis, and recommendations, written for a reviewing analyst.
Wrote a custom correlation rule for repeated SSH failures from a single source and analysed how IP rotation, slow brute force, and password spraying would evade it.

Documented deployment procedures, investigation findings, and recommended security improvements.
